answer: Diversity in Pottery Decoration and Diversity in Pottery Form first show opposite growth trends in the transition from the 18th into the 17th century BCE — that is, between the 1800 BCE and 1700 BCE century anchors (≈3750–3650 calBP). Over this century, Pottery Decoration rose significantly by +1.45 z-units (from −0.48 to +0.97) while Pottery Form declined by −1.87 z-units (from +0.74 to −1.13). This is the FIRST — and the only — century interval across the entire 4100–500 BCE series in which the two move in opposite directions with Decoration clearly up and Form clearly down (it is the sole interval where ΔDecoration > 0 AND ΔForm < 0 out of all 36 century-to-century transitions); the first data point that registers the new regime is the 1700 BCE anchor. The divergence is a sustained regime change, not a one-century flicker: Pottery Form then holds at −1.13 and Pottery Decoration at +0.97 (later +1.53) for the following centuries.

payload.hypothesis: Pottery Decoration and Pottery Form first diverge in the transition from the 18th into the 17th century BCE (between the 1800 BCE and 1700 BCE anchors, ≈3750–3650 calBP), with Pottery Decoration rising by +1.45 z (−0.48→+0.97) while Pottery Form declines by −1.87 z (+0.74→−1.13); this is the first and only century interval in the 4100–500 BCE series with ΔDecoration>0 and ΔForm<0, and it becomes a sustained regime.
payload.workflow: 1) Built the century-level series from time_series_data.csv raw anchors (CE=−4100…−500 in strict 100-yr steps, calBP=1950−CE), cross-validated against capital.csv (exact match, max diff 0.0). 2) Growth = first difference in z-units per consecutive century bin. 3) Scanned chronologically for the earliest interval with ΔDecoration>0 AND ΔForm<0. 4) Robustness checks: (a) annual linear-interpolated series — first qualifying year is 1799 BCE, none earlier; (b) sustained regime confirmed (Form −1.13 / Decoration ≥+0.97 for 13-plus anchors; earliest 200-yr opposite net-change window 1900→1700 contains the same transition); (c) capital.csv alone reproduces the identical result. 5) Threshold sensitivity verified identical under |Δ| thresholds 0.0–1.4. Artifacts: artifacts/analysis/solution.py, artifacts/analysis/result.json.
